about: Hand labels of the FIRST drafts (debug.draft_answer) of the Copilot 3.3 DEV split, collected live from the deployed 3.2 pipeline on 2026-10-17 (eval/copilot33_answers_baseline32.json). Written from the draft + tool data only (eval/copilot33_eval.py view), before any detector was run on these answers. Single annotator (the same agent that writes the 3.3 rules) - see the limitations in docs/ANALYSIS/AI_COPILOT_3_3_EVALUATION.md. Categories use the 3.2 vocabulary; critical = an error of a category the 3.2 policy treats as critical (a wrong figure, period, entity, trend, ranking...).
